rows.reasoning: Wichgers coauthored and voted Aye (50-43) on AB 103 (2025), a single-subject bill whose operative section bars staff from using a name or pronouns not aligned with a minor's biological sex "without written authorization from the pupil’s parent or legal guardian". That matches the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns" and goes beyond mere notification. His votes for the multi-subject parental-rights bills AB 963 and AB 510 point the same way but do not seat the chair on their own.
